name: Being Steadfast
overview: Scripture calls believers to remain steadfast by trusting in God's protection and enduring mercy, recognizing Him as a strong refuge in times of trouble. Despite facing trials and opposition, Christians are encouraged not to fear those who can harm the body but to revere God who holds eternal authority. Through prayer and thanksgiving, believers find peace and strength to persevere in doing good, confident that perseverance will yield a fruitful reward in God's timing.
